tagline: Custom Finish Contractor in the Wyoming Valley

team_members.name: Joshua Prezkop
team_members.bio: Started Prezkop Builders in 2021 after coming up through residential construction and finish carpentry. Josh runs every estimate himself and is on site for the detail work — including the hardwood refinishing he still does alongside his father.

team_members.name: Jacob Campbell
team_members.bio: Runs the day-to-day on outdoor living and remodeling jobs, keeps the schedule honest, and is usually the one customers hear from when the weather moves a deck build.

team_members.name: Jimmy Hans
team_members.bio: Framing through finish. Decks, porches, trim, and the small structural repairs most contractors would rather not quote.

why_choose_us.title: You hear from us — every day
why_choose_us.description: The most common complaint about contractors in this valley is silence. Our customers say the opposite, in writing: prompt every day, kept up to date the entire time, quick to respond.

why_choose_us.title: Custom finish, not production work
why_choose_us.description: We are a custom finish contractor. Crawl space doors, special-order window wells, stair treads, a sidewalk that has to sit right — the detail jobs other outfits pass on are the ones we built this business around.

why_choose_us.title: PA licensed and insured
why_choose_us.description: PA Home Improvement Contractor license PA164836, registered with the Pennsylvania Office of the Attorney General. Prezkop Builders, LLC since April 2021.

why_choose_us.title: A crew of three you'll recognize
why_choose_us.description: Josh, Jake and Jimmy. Nobody gets handed off to a crew you've never met, and the owner is on site — not just on the estimate.
